overall_assessment: Anonymization works well for HiVolda. None of the 20 plans keeps a staff name, e-mail or phone number, and a scan of all 667 offerings found none either. Apart from the functional address studentsorvis@hivolda.no, the only text removed is the semester-year value after 'Undervisningssemester:'/'Eksamenssemester:' (1,334 of 1,346 spans). Government-document dates ('av 22. mars 2018', 'fastsett 18. mars 2013', lovdata '2014-12-04-1697') and the programme name 'Barnehagelærarutdaning - arbeidsplassbasert 2016' are kept as they should be. Both pre-pass flags are false alarms. name_like fires on every offering because of the flattened exam-table header ('Gruppering\tVarighet', 'Karakterskala\tAndel') and on organisation or product names ('Support Office', 'Adobe Connect', 'Times New Roman'), so the packet has no random controls. The single admin_date flag is those government-document dates. The only leak is a schedule year in brackets after week numbers, in 4 of 667 offerings. Outside the packet, so not filed as a finding: in 4 MGL1-7MA1B2 offerings the season rule removes the whole word 'haustsemesteret'/'vårsemesteret' from the exam-table comment 'Nasjonal deleksamen haustsemesteret', which loses when the exam is held (low).

findings.evidence: Samling 4: veke 3 (2023) - Om oppgåveskriving, presentasjon og tid til rettleiing … Samlinger. Uke 44 og uke 4 (2017).
findings.description: Session schedules in 'Praktisk organisering' give the offering's calendar year in brackets after week numbers ('veke 3 (2023)', 'veke 11 (2023)', 'Uke 44 og uke 4 (2017)'). The year dates the plan to one offering, as a semester label with a year does ('Høst 2024'), so under the rubric it is an administrative date and should be removed. The week numbers are teaching organisation and may stay. It is not personal data. The packet has 2 of 20 offerings with it; all 667 HiVolda offerings have 4 (also DRHS902-1_2019 'veke 15 og 21 (2019)' and MEI304-1_2019 'veke 4 (2020)').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The year rules in .anon_generic() (R/anonymize.R) remove a year only next to a season word ('Høst 2024'), after an admin keyword ('Opprettet 2020') or in an academic-year range ('2023/24'). No rule covers a bracketed year after a week reference, and .anon_hivolda() only strips the 'Emneansvarleg:' and 'Godkjent av:' blocks.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_generic() (or .anon_hivolda()), drop the bracketed year after a week reference and keep the weeks: stringr::str_replace_all("(?i)(\\b(?:veke|uke|week)[ \\t]*\\d{1,2}(?:[ \\t]*(?:og|and|,|[-–])[ \\t]*(?:(?:veke|uke|week)[ \\t]*)?\\d{1,2})*)[ \\t]*\\((?:19|20)\\d{2}\\)", "\\1"). This gives 'veke 3', 'Uke 44 og uke 4', 'veke 15 og 21'. A reference year such as 'Hvattum, M. (2015)' has no week word before it and stays. Add these three cases and one reference-year case to tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R.
